module_summary: AXI-stream virtual FIFO: input sfifo buffers stream data, full bursts are written to external AXI memory at a wrapping address, read back by burst into an output sfifo, with credit counters preventing overflow.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TVALID
anchors.why: Incoming stream valid; with TREADY writes data into the input FIFO.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TREADY
anchors.why: Stream ready, deasserted on soft reset, input FIFO full or virtual FIFO full.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TDATA
anchors.why: Incoming stream data written into the input sfifo.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TVALID
anchors.why: Outgoing stream valid whenever output FIFO is non-empty.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TDATA
anchors.why: Outgoing stream data read from the output sfifo.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TREADY
anchors.why: Downstream ready; pops output FIFO and frees FIFO credit.

anchors.name: vfifo_fill
anchors.why: Total items in virtual FIFO; incremented on stream in, decremented on stream out.

anchors.name: vfifo_full
anchors.why: Virtual FIFO full; blocks TREADY and new write bursts.

anchors.name: soft_reset
anchors.why: Soft reset held until bus idle; resets FIFOs, counters and stops burst issue.

anchors.name: writes_idle
anchors.why: No write bursts outstanding; needed to release soft reset.

anchors.name: reads_idle
anchors.why: No read bursts outstanding; needed to release soft reset.

anchors.name: mem_space_available_w
anchors.why: Uncommitted external memory space in bursts; gates start_write.

anchors.name: mem_data_available_w
anchors.why: Bursts written and acknowledged but not yet read; gates start_read.

anchors.name: writes_outstanding
anchors.why: Write bursts issued awaiting BVALID; determines writes_idle.

anchors.name: reads_outstanding
anchors.why: Read bursts issued awaiting RLAST; determines reads_idle.

anchors.name: ofifo_space_available
anchors.why: Output FIFO space credit reserved per read burst; gates start_read.

anchors.name: start_write
anchors.why: Launches a write burst when input FIFO holds a burst and memory space exists.

anchors.name: start_read
anchors.why: Launches a read burst when memory data and output FIFO space are available.

anchors.name: phantom_write
anchors.why: One-cycle registered start_write; updates write credit counters, spaces bursts.

anchors.name: phantom_read
anchors.why: One-cycle registered start_read; updates read credit counters, spaces bursts.

anchors.name: axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Virtual FIFO write pointer in memory; advances one burst per accepted AW.

anchors.name: axi_araddr
anchors.why: Virtual FIFO read pointer in memory; advances one burst per accepted AR.

anchors.name: writes_pending
anchors.why: Beats remaining in current write burst; generates WLAST.

anchors.name: skd_valid
anchors.why: One-element buffer valid between input FIFO and WDATA; controls FIFO read.

anchors.name: skd_data
anchors.why: One-element buffer of input FIFO data driving M_AXI_WDATA.

anchors.name: read_from_fifo
anchors.why: Input FIFO read enable when buffer empty or write beat accepted.

anchors.name: write_to_fifo
anchors.why: Output FIFO write enable on each accepted read beat.

anchors.name: ififo_fill
anchors.why: Input FIFO occupancy; a full burst triggers start_write.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Write data to external memory from skid buffer.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Read data from external memory written into output FIFO.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Write burst address valid, registered from start_write.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Write data valid for burst beats; also counts write beats.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Read burst address valid, registered from start_read.

anchors.name: M_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response; makes written burst available and retires outstanding writes.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RLAST
anchors.why: Last read beat; frees memory space and retires outstanding reads.

anchors.name: o_err
anchors.why: Sticky bus error from BRESP/RRESP; halts all burst issue.

anchors.name: o_overflow
anchors.why: Flags stream protocol violation when stalled data changes.

anchors.name: o_fill
anchors.why: Reports virtual FIFO fill count.

anchors.name: o_mm2s_full
anchors.why: Output FIFO holds at least one full burst.

groups.name: input_fifo
groups.description: sfifo buffering incoming stream words until a full burst is ready.

groups.name: write_skid_buffer
groups.description: One-element buffer decoupling input FIFO from AXI write data.

groups.name: write_burst_engine
groups.description: Issues aligned fixed-length write bursts to memory, generating AW, W and WLAST.

groups.name: read_burst_engine
groups.description: Issues fixed-length read bursts when data and output FIFO space exist.

groups.name: output_fifo
groups.description: sfifo collecting read-back data and presenting it as the output stream.

groups.name: occupancy_accounting
groups.description: Fill, memory space/data credits and outstanding burst counters.

groups.name: soft_reset_control
groups.description: Holds FIFOs in reset until outstanding bursts drain.

groups.name: error_status
groups.description: Bus error, stream overflow detection and fill/empty status outputs.
